activationAudioAlignment.scope: Diagnostic application of the plan target to local activation and actual audio ring-clock samples. All startup/seek/paused rows retained. adapterSummary.outputDrainScope: latest accepted output completed and has a resolved drawable callback or observed unavailable drawable acquisition; zero callbacks and unavailable attempts do not certify visible presentation

frameInventoryScope: All 73 raw completed engine frame records are included unchanged, including 12 warmup records and the completed but unpresented .100-second frame. First positive drawable times and last-redraw A/V offsets are different observations and must not be paired as one timestamped measurement.
limitations: No GPU or model rerun. No altered source, runtime, raw log or prior report.
Temporal witnesses are sampled observations; requests/enqueued feedback are not acknowledgments.
Frame first-presentation timestamps and last-redraw offsets must never be paired as an atomic measurement.
No invented physical synchronization, perceptual, Live throughput, energy, or M5 acceptance threshold.
The full lifecycle control is not accepted: both initial-pause completion and activation witnesses remain missing.
Other passing checks do not remove the two failed checks or establish physical HDR, sustained Live throughput, energy efficiency, or M5 performance.
Artifact and source paths are workspace-relative provenance labels; no user-home paths or window titles are exported.
